brief.claim: Mowing raises plant species richness in grassland: mean species richness in mown plots is higher than in unmown plots, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: species count in each mown plot at each monthly survey, in time order
species count in each unmown plot at each monthly survey, in time order

brief.sizes: 6 plots per treatment, 12 monthly surveys per plot (144 values in total).
